data.name: BotDescription
data.value:
🤖 ChatGPT + images
Just type a question — the bot replies with conversation context. Menu: new chat, models, images (GPT IMAGE 1 / GPT Image 2), photo animation, account and ⭐ top-up.
Free daily limits apply — see /profile. Details: /help

data.name: HelpText
data.value:
🤖 Full guide
🌐 Website The same ChatGPT chat and image tools are also available in the browser: https://gptips.skolkokomu.ru Sign in with Telegram — your ⭐ balance and quotas are shared with the bot.
💬 Chat with AI Just send a text message — the bot replies using the current conversation context. • 💬 New chat — reset context and start fresh • 🤖 Model — choose a ChatGPT model — GPT-4o mini: uses the free daily quota — other models: Stars only
🎨 Images Open “🎨 Images” in the menu: • 🖼 GPT IMAGE 1 — free text-to-image (within daily quota) • 🎨 GPT Image 2 — paid generation with size and quality options • 🛠 Edit photo — edit a photo from a text instruction (paid, GPT Image 2) • 📝 Text from photo — OCR / extract text from an image • 🪄 Prompt from photo — create a text-to-image prompt from an uploaded picture
🪄 Prompt from photo Send an image — the bot writes a prompt that can generate a similar picture (uses ChatGPT quota or ⭐).
✨ Animate photo Turn a photo into a short animation (free within quota or paid with ⭐).
👤 Account Shows your ⭐ balance, free quotas, and current model. From account you can: • choose a model • top up balance • switch interface language
⭐ Balance and limits Free requests are limited and refresh daily. When the quota is used up, top up ⭐ in Account or via /deposit. Guide: 1⭐ ≈ 10 ChatGPT requests, 2 image generations, or 2 photo animations.
Useful commands /start — main menu /help — this guide /profile — account /model — choose model /images — images menu /image — GPT IMAGE 1 /gpt_image — GPT Image 2 /edit_image — edit photo /prompt_from_image — prompt from photo /animate — animate photo /get_image_text — OCR /deposit — top up /reset_context — new chat /donate — support the project
In groups: /ask, /image, /summary
Support: @my_super_ultra_smart_bot
